question: When was PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**February 2024.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana was launched on **1 February 2024** by the Government of India.
 
• This scheme focuses on **providing free electricity** to households through solar power generation.
 
• It aims to **promote renewable energy**, reduce dependency on conventional energy sources, and cut down household electricity expenses.
 
• Under this initiative, households are encouraged to **install solar panels** for their own electricity consumption.
 
• The scheme aligns with India’s broader renewable energy goals and contributes to the nation’s environmental sustainability efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana**

 
 
• The scheme is part of India’s commitment to sustainability and renewable energy transition.
 
• It encourages the adoption of rooftop solar panel installations among households, supporting the National Solar Mission.
 
• It is expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and promote self-sufficient energy production in rural and urban areas.
 
• The initiative addresses the dual goals of energy affordability and environmental sustainability.
